status_summary: Executive Order 14153 (signed 2025-01-20) directs Interior to review Alaska waterways for navigability with the State and prepare recordable disclaimers of interest. No blanket secretarial order shifting the burden of proof was found. BLM instead issued case-by-case decisions: on 2026-06-04 it announced four navigability decisions (Delta-Tangle, Fortymile tributaries, Kwethluk and Goodnews), the first for Alaska submerged lands since 2019, and on 2026-07-24 it found the Unuk River navigable at statehood and approved a disclaimer.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14153 signed, directing Interior to review Alaska waterways for navigability with the State and to prepare recordable disclaimers of interest restoring ownership to the State as appropriate.
BLM announced four navigability decisions recognizing State of Alaska ownership of submerged lands under named river systems.
BLM approved a recordable disclaimer for the Unuk River after finding it navigable at statehood.
